risks: keep subject readable at small mobile size
fixes: add explicit no-text rule to every scene contract
anchor each scene with one main subject
active_skill_rules: Open with a quiet observation.
Make the idea feel reusable tomorrow.
Prefer steady pacing and clear everyday actions.
Avoid urgency, hype, and dramatic conflict.
Warm daylight, soft shadows, clean surfaces.
Human-scale framing and believable home details.
Minimal props, no labels, no papers, no screens.
Colors should feel fresh, neutral, and warm without looking beige-only.
First beat notices a small everyday moment.
Hook phrasing should feel gentle and specific.
Visual opening should be quiet but clear.
Avoid shock, countdowns, or exaggerated urgency.
Compile positive-only image prompts from scene contracts, not topic titles or debug notes.
Use concrete physical subjects, environments, actions, camera language, lighting, mood, and composition.
Keep prompts text-sparse and visual-first for HiDream-O1-Dev.
Default image generation uses HiDream-O1-Dev at 28 inference steps.
Preserve the selected scene order and one clear visual subject per keyframe.
Ground each prompt in the scene contract's physical objects, environment, action, camera, and lighting.
Do not create poster layouts, typography compositions, title cards, quote cards, UI screens, or social-media graphics.
Prefer photographed, practical visual moments over symbolic diagrams or written explanations.
Do not generate readable text, fake text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, UI, screens, captions, subtitles, watermarks, documents, charts, paper labels, or distorted letters.
Use text-sparse visual composition and avoid any written-word focal point.

Add negative prompt terms for readable text, typography, logos, labels, UI, screens, captions, subtitles, watermarks, documents, charts, poster, title card, quote card, headline, and social media graphic.
Use plain unmarked surfaces for notebooks, mugs, packages, walls, screens, signs, and paper-like objects.
Block any composition that depends on written words, centered headlines, text overlays, or poster-style graphic design.
Motion prompts should preserve the keyframe subject and scene contract.
Use one primary camera move per shot.
Keep motion physically plausible.
Avoid text overlays and UI transitions.
Voice direction should be clear, natural, and concise.
Calm modes use measured pacing and soft emphasis.
Fast modes use tighter pacing without shouting.
Missing script or voice values must stay unknown.
